newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CS First Boston starts Mezogep with 'buy'.
newsitem.headline: CS First Boston starts Mezogep with 'buy'.

text.p: CS First Boston on Friday initiated coverage of Hungarian machinery company Mezogep Rt with a "buy" saying the company's first quarter results were "even better than expected."

"Underlying performance in terms of sales growth in the automotive and agricultural equipment business lines coupled with wider margins suggest remarkable earnings in the future," analysts Spencer Jakab and Pal Bogar said in a company report.
Mezogep released its first quarter figures on Wednesday and said it boosted its operating profit from 133 million forints to 263 million forints in the first three months of the year.
However, its net profit fell to 58 million forints from 88 million forints in January-March 1996 due to one-off exchange rate losses.
"(A fall in net earnings) is the result of non-recurring currency losses that are expected to reverse themselves into currency gains later in the year," the analysts said.
On Friday Mezogep shares finished at a new record high of 2,850 forints, up 150.
